Spells of consecutive flagged days

Source: R/calc_spell.R
calc_spell.Rd

For every flag column registered by an earlier step (thresholds, percentiles, conditions), finds runs of consecutive flagged days and records the length of each run of at least min_spell days on its last day. day_abv_30 gives spell_abv_30. Replaces find_spell() of climatic4economist.

Usage

calc_spell(x, min_spell = NULL, id = NULL, label = NULL, chunk = "auto")

Arguments

x

A long table with flag columns, e.g. from calc_threshold_day().

min_spell

Minimum number of consecutive days that make a spell.

id

Optional name of the unit identifier column.

label

Optional name shown in progress messages.

chunk

"auto" splits the work by unit when it would not fit in memory; a whole number forces that many units per chunk; FALSE never splits.

Value

x with one spell column per flag column, integer, NA except on the last day of each spell.

Details

min_spell defaults to the one used by earlier spells of the same table, announced, and otherwise to 2. A missing value ends a run.

See also

Other indicators: calc_condition(), calc_heatwave(), calc_par(), calc_percentile(), calc_percentile_day(), calc_spell_excess(), calc_spell_percentile(), calc_std_index(), calc_std_threshold(), calc_threshold_day()

Examples

x <- update_meta(
  tibble::tibble(ID = "1", date = as.Date("2022-01-01") + 0:5,
                 value = c(31, 32, 29, 33, 34, 35)),
  key = "ID", date_col = "date", shape = "long", unit = "C")
calc_threshold_day(x, above = 30) |> calc_spell(min_spell = 2)
#> Using `unit = "C"` from upstream unit.
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#> # Context:  value [C], long; key ID; 3 indicators
#>   ID    date       value day_abv_30 C_abv_30 spell_abv_30
#>   <chr> <date>     <dbl> <lgl>         <dbl>        <int>
#> 1 1     2022-01-01    31 TRUE              1           NA
#> 2 1     2022-01-02    32 TRUE              2            2
#> 3 1     2022-01-03    29 FALSE             0           NA
#> 4 1     2022-01-04    33 TRUE              3           NA
#> 5 1     2022-01-05    34 TRUE              4           NA
#> 6 1     2022-01-06    35 TRUE              5            3
